name: 심예은

tips.주어-동사: my house, my city처럼 하나면 have가 아니라 has!
tips.동사·시제: 일반동사(spend) 앞에 I'm을 붙이지 않기. interested 같은 형용사 앞에는 am을 꼭.
tips.문장 구조: 한 문장에 동사는 하나! are makes ❌ → make. love 뒤 동사는 -ing: love drawing. be·seem·feel·remain 뒤에는 형용사: he seems happy.
tips.관사·전치사: a high school student처럼 사람·직업 앞에 a. 날짜는 on the 7th of April.
tips.단어 선택: neighbour는 이웃 사람, neighbourhood는 동네. refreshed만 반복하지 말고 바꿔 말하기. 기분은 relaxed·stressed, 그게 주는 느낌은 relaxing·stressful.
tips.발음·철자: -ed 끝소리(t/d/id)를 흘리지 말고 또렷하게. I'm과 I도 구분해서 발음.

focus.6: having said that, on top of that, I have to admit 같은 연결어를 Part 3 답에 꼭 한 번씩 넣어보기!
focus.7: usually만 반복하지 말고 more often than not, on a regular basis로 바꿔 말해보기!
focus.8: Part 2 서론 정확하게 암기하기! be·seem·feel 뒤에는 형용사(happy, calm) 쓰기.

compare: neighbour / neighbourhood
neighbour 이웃 사람 · neighbourhood 동네, 사는 지역
to / past (시간)
It's a 5-minute walk / It takes 5 minutes
It's a 5-minute walk. minute 단수, 하이픈 · It takes 5 minutes on foot. minutes 복수
make people closer / bring people together
It brings people together. 사람들을 하나로 모으다 · It makes people closer to each other. to를 빼먹지 않기
lose my temper / throw a fit / tell someone off
lose my temper 욱하다 · throw a fit 성질을 부리다 · tell someone off 꾸짖다 · hold back my anger 화를 참다
relaxed / relaxing · stressed / stressful
내 기분은 -ed: I'm relaxed / stressed / interested · 그게 주는 느낌은 -ing / -ful: It's relaxing / stressful / interesting
near / nearby
near + 장소: near my house · nearby는 혼자: There's a park nearby. / a nearby park
on / in (때)
on weekdays, on weekends, on Monday · 영국식 at the weekend도 OK (at the weekends ❌) · in May, in winter, in 2026
used to / be used to
used to + 동사원형: 예전엔 ~했다 · be used to + -ing: ~에 익숙하다
dead / die
dead 형용사: My battery is dead · die 동사: My phone died
introvert / introverted
an introvert 내향적인 사람(명사) · introverted 내향적인(형용사)

cards.ko: 우리 집에는 방이 세 개 있어요.
cards.en: My house has three rooms.
cards.gram: 주어가 my house(하나)라서 have가 아니라 has. he/she/it, my house에는 has!

cards.en: I usually spend my weekends at home.
cards.mine: I'm usually spend my weekends at home.
cards.gram:
spend는 일반동사라 앞에 I'm(I am)을 붙이지 않아요. I usually spend.
I'm vs I · I'm 발음이 습관처럼 붙지 않게 조심! be동사 + 동사원형은 틀려요.

cards.en: I am interested in art.
cards.gram:
interested는 형용사라 be동사가 필요해요. I am interested in + 관심 있는 것.
interested vs interesting · 내 기분은 interested, 대상이 재밌으면 interesting: Art is interesting.

cards.ko: 우리 고향은 대중교통이 더 좋아지면 개선될 수 있어요.
cards.en: My hometown could be improved by having better public transport.
cards.gram: '개선될 수 있다'는 could be improved. 주어(my hometown)를 꼭 넣고, 방법은 by + -ing로 붙여요. 철자도 improved!

cards.en: They make me happy.
cards.gram:
한 문장에 동사는 하나만! are와 makes를 같이 쓰면 안 돼요. 주어가 they(복수)라 make.
make + 사람 + 형용사 · It makes me happy. / They make me happy.

cards.ko: 아침 일찍 일어나면 하루를 알차게 보내는 기분이에요.
cards.en: Waking up early in the morning makes me feel productive.
cards.gram: 아침 자체가 아니라 '아침에 일찍 일어나는 것'이 주어예요. 동작을 주어로 쓸 땐 -ing: Waking up early in the morning makes me ~.

cards.ko: 저는 그림 그리는 걸 정말 좋아해요.
cards.en: I love drawing.
cards.gram: 동사 뒤에 또 동사가 오면 -ing나 to로 연결해요: love drawing / love to draw.

cards.en: Sports bring people together.
cards.mine: It makes people closer each other.
cards.gram:
closer each other는 어색해요. 사람들을 모은다는 뜻은 bring people together가 자연스러워요.
같은 뜻 다른 표현 · It makes people closer to each other. / Sports can create connections between people.

cards.en: When I was a high school student, I liked science.
cards.gram: 사람·신분 앞에는 관사 a를 붙여요: a high school student, a teacher.

cards.en: My birthday is on the 7th of April.
cards.gram:
날짜 앞에는 on, 날짜는 서수로 the 7th of April(= April 7th).
in vs on · 달은 in April, 날짜는 on the 7th.

cards.ko: 저는 더 재미있는 사람이 되고 싶어요.
cards.en: I want to be a funnier person.
cards.gram: person 앞에 a를 꼭! 비교급 funnier가 들어가도 a funnier person.

cards.en: My neighbourhood is quiet and safe.
cards.gram:
동네는 neighbourhood, 이웃 사람은 neighbour.
neighbour vs neighbourhood · My neighbours are friendly. (사람) / My neighbourhood is quiet. (지역)

cards.en: Going for a walk makes me feel recharged.
cards.gram: refreshed를 너무 자주 써요. 바꿔 쓸 표현: recharged, energised, relaxed, clear-headed.

cards.en: I watched the match and I was really excited.
cards.gram: -ed 끝소리를 더 명확하게! watched는 /t/, excited는 /id/, played는 /d/. 흘리면 현재형처럼 들려요.

cards.en: I'm not a picky eater.
cards.gram: picky eater = 편식하는 사람. 부정은 I'm not a picky eater.

cards.ko: 그 사장님이랑 처음 만나자마자 잘 맞았어
cards.en: I hit it off with the owner as soon as we met.
cards.gram: hit it off = (처음 만나서) 죽이 잘 맞다. hit it off with + 사람.

cards.ko: 우리는 같은 기수였어. 그녀는 내 입사 동기야.
cards.en: We were in the same batch. She is my batchmate.
cards.gram:
batch = 동기, 기수. in the same batch = 같은 기수(동기)인, batchmate = 동기 한 명.
batch vs classmate · 학교 같은 반은 classmate, 입학·입사 같은 기수는 batchmate.

cards.en: I can't be bothered to cook in the evening.
cards.gram: I can't be bothered to + 동사 = ~하기 귀찮다. What do you hate doing? 질문에 딱이에요.

cards.en: I learnt the piano half-heartedly as a child.
cards.gram: half-heartedly = 건성으로, 마지못해. 반대는 wholeheartedly(진심으로).

cards.en: I usually wake up at 10 to 7.

cards.ko: 맛이 그렇게 나쁘진 않았어, 더 별로인 것도 먹어봤어
cards.en: It wasn't that bad. I've eaten worse.
cards.gram: I've eaten worse = 이보다 더 별로인 것도 먹어봤다(그럭저럭 괜찮다). 일에는 I've done worse.

cards.ko: 시험을 완벽하게 보진 못했지만, 더 못 본 적도 있어
cards.en: I didn't do perfectly in the exam, but I've done worse.
cards.gram: I've done worse = 더 못한 적도 있다, 이 정도면 괜찮다.

cards.en: I'm going to stay in my current job for the time being.
cards.gram: for the time being = 당분간, 일단은.

cards.ko: 그 강의는 생각할 거리를 많이 줬어
cards.en: The lecture gave me a lot of food for thought.
cards.gram: food for thought = 생각할 거리. 책·영화·강의 이야기할 때 써요.

cards.ko: 좋은 직업이 여러 개 있지만, 지금 바로 떠오르는 건 인플루언서야
cards.en: There are several good jobs, but among them, being an influencer comes to mind off the top of my head.
cards.gram: off the top of my head = 바로 떠오르는 대로. among them과 함께 Part 2 서론에 써먹기!

cards.en: My school is a 5-minute walk away.
cards.gram:
a 5-minute walk = 걸어서 5분. minute은 단수로 붙여 써요.
바꿔 쓰기 · a 5-minute drive / flight / bus ride / bike ride / train ride / subway ride.

cards.en: My manager is a bit bossy.
cards.gram: bossy = 이래라저래라 하는, 대장 노릇 하는.

cards.ko: 그 선수는 항상 시간을 잘 지켜
cards.en: The athlete is always punctual.
cards.gram: punctual = 시간을 잘 지키는. 성공한 사람의 자질 말할 때 좋아요.

cards.en: My mum is a warm-hearted person.
cards.gram: warm-hearted = 마음이 따뜻한, 다정한.

cards.en: My friend is mature for her age.
cards.gram: mature = 성숙한. mature for her age = 나이에 비해 성숙한.

cards.en: He's famous, but he's really down to earth.
cards.gram: down to earth = 소탈한, 현실적인. 잘난 척 안 하는 사람.

cards.en: Money-wise, it's the best job.
cards.gram: 명사 + -wise = ~적인 측면에서: money-wise, health-wise, time-wise.

cards.en: The shop has a good reputation.
cards.gram: reputation = 평판, 명성. have a good reputation, build a reputation.

cards.en: It's not confirmed yet.
cards.gram: It's not confirmed yet = 아직 확정되지 않았어. 계획을 물을 때 답하기 좋아요.

cards.ko: 스포츠는 사람들 사이를 연결해 줄 수 있어
cards.en: Sports can create connections between people.
cards.gram: create connections between + 사람들 = ~ 사이를 이어주다. bring people together와 같이 써요.

cards.en: I like listening to music as well.
cards.gram: as well = ~도, 또한. 문장 끝에 붙여요. too와 같은 뜻.

cards.ko: 지금까지는 그 폰이 아주 마음에 들어
cards.en: So far, I'm really happy with the phone.
cards.gram: so far = 지금까지는. 현재완료와도 잘 어울려요: So far, it has worked well.

cards.en: Online shopping is fine.
cards.gram: fine = 괜찮은, 무난한. 아주 좋진 않아도 문제없을 때 써요.

cards.en: What's your neighbourhood like?
cards.gram: What's ~ like? = ~는 어때? 여기서 like는 '좋아하다'가 아니라 '~ 같은'. 동네 분위기·특징을 설명하면 돼요.

cards.en: My nephew threw a fit over a toy.
cards.gram: throw a fit = 성질을 부리다, 떼를 쓰다. 과거는 threw a fit.

cards.en: I rarely lose my temper.
cards.gram: lose my temper = 욱하다, 화를 내다. Are you a patient person? 질문에 딱.

cards.en: People who cut in line really piss me off.
cards.gram: piss someone off = ~를 열받게 하다(거친 구어체라 시험에선 피하기). 부드럽게는 make me angry.

cards.en: My teacher told me off when I was a child.
cards.gram: tell someone off = ~를 꾸짖다, 혼내다. 사람이 tell과 off 사이에 와요.

cards.en: I hold back my anger at work.
cards.gram: hold back my anger = 화를 참다. hold back tears(눈물을 참다)도 같은 구조.

cards.ko: 기술은 편리해. 그렇긴 해도 너무 의존하면 안 돼
cards.en: Technology is convenient. Having said that, we shouldn't rely on it too much.
cards.gram: Having said that = 그렇긴 하지만. 앞 말과 반대 의견을 덧붙일 때 쓰는 연결어.

cards.ko: 그 폰은 가볍고, 게다가 배터리도 오래가
cards.en: The phone is light, and on top of that, the battery lasts a long time.
cards.gram: on top of that = 게다가. 장점을 하나 더 덧붙일 때 쓰는 연결어.

cards.ko: 솔직히 말하면 나는 최신 기기를 사는 걸 좋아해
cards.en: I have to admit, I love buying the latest gadgets.
cards.gram: I have to admit = 인정하자면, 솔직히. 내 이야기를 꺼낼 때 자연스러운 연결어.

cards.ko: 이 문제를 한 번에 해결할 방법은 없어
cards.en: There's no magic bullet for this problem.
cards.gram: magic bullet / silver bullet = 한 방에 해결하는 방법, 만능 해결책. 주로 There's no ~ 로 써요.

cards.ko: SNS가 외로움을 해결해 주는 만능 해결책은 아니야
cards.en: Social media isn't a silver bullet for loneliness.
cards.gram: silver bullet = magic bullet과 같은 뜻. Part 3에서 '그게 다 해결해 주진 않는다' 말할 때 좋아요.

cards.en: The area has a reputation for being safe.
cards.gram: have a reputation for + 명사/-ing = ~로 평판이 나 있다.

cards.ko: 우리 도시는 아이를 키우기 좋은 곳이에요
cards.en: My city is a good place to bring up children.
cards.gram: a good place to bring up children = 아이 키우기 좋은 곳. bring up = raise(기르다).

cards.en: More often than not, I sleep in on weekends.
cards.gram: more often than not = 대체로, 대개. usually 대신 쓰면 다양해 보여요.

cards.en: I work out on a regular basis.
cards.gram: on a regular basis = 정기적으로, 꾸준히. usually·regularly 대신.

cards.en: Even though eight hours is ideal, I only get seven hours of sleep.
cards.gram:
even though + 문장, 문장 = ~이긴 하지만. 한 문장 안에 but을 같이 쓰지 않기.
but으로 · Eight hours is ideal, but I only sleep for seven hours.

cards.ko: 주중에는 일찍 일어나고, 주말에는 늦게 일어나요.
cards.en: I get up early on weekdays and late on weekends.
cards.gram: 주중·주말 모두 on: on weekdays, on weekends, on Monday. 영국에서는 at the weekend도 많이 써요(at the weekends ❌). 달·계절·연도는 in: in May, in winter.

cards.en: The bus doesn't come very frequently.
cards.gram: 버스가 자주 다니다 = come / run frequently. The buses don't run very often.

cards.ko: 저는 보통 아침에 일어나서 물을 마셔요.
cards.en: I usually drink a glass of water when I wake up.
cards.gram: 습관은 현재형! usually는 일반동사 앞: I usually drink. '일어나서'는 when I wake up / after I get up.

cards.en: I feel relaxed when I stay at home on weekends.
cards.gram: 사람의 기분은 -ed: I feel relaxed / stressed / interested. 그게 주는 느낌은 -ing: It's relaxing / stressful / interesting.

cards.en: Exam season is really stressful.
cards.gram: 상황·일이 스트레스를 줄 때는 stressful, 내가 스트레스 받을 때는 I'm stressed. stressful 철자: s 두 개, l 하나.

cards.en: There's a park near my house.
cards.gram: near + 장소 = ~ 근처에(뒤에 장소가 와요). nearby는 혼자 써요: There's a park nearby. / a nearby park.

cards.en: Korean food is really tasty.
cards.gram: food는 셀 수 없는 명사! a food ❌, foods ❌ → food is. 종류를 말할 땐 dishes: Korean dishes are tasty.

cards.en: We are close.
cards.gram: 친하다 = be close(형용사). closely는 '자세히, 밀접하게'라는 부사라 be 뒤에 못 와요. We're close friends.

cards.ko: 그 영화 정말 지루했어요. 저는 거의 잠들 뻔했어요.
cards.en: The film was really boring. I nearly fell asleep.
cards.gram: 영화가 주는 느낌은 -ing: The film was boring. 내가 지루하면 -ed: I was bored. (I was boring ❌ = 내가 지루한 사람이었다)

cards.ko: 저는 그 소식을 듣고 정말 놀랐어요.
cards.en: I was really surprised by the news.
cards.gram: 내가 느낀 감정은 -ed: I was surprised. 소식이 주는 느낌은 -ing: The news was surprising.

cards.en: I'm exhausted because I have so much work these days.
cards.gram: 내 상태는 -ed: I'm exhausted / tired. 일이 지치게 만들면 -ing: My job is exhausting / tiring.

cards.ko: 저는 역사에 관심이 많아요. 역사는 정말 흥미로워요.
cards.en: I'm really interested in history. It's so interesting.
cards.gram: 사람은 interested in + 대상, 대상은 interesting. I'm interesting ❌ = 내가 흥미로운 사람이다.

cards.ko: 그 콘서트는 정말 신났고, 저도 엄청 들떴어요.
cards.en: The concert was really exciting, and I was so excited.
cards.gram: 콘서트(대상)는 exciting, 나(사람)는 excited. 한 문장에 둘 다 넣어 연습해 보세요.

cards.en: I had a wild guess.
cards.gram: wild guess = 어림짐작, 대충 찍기. 모르는 질문엔 I had a wild guess / I'd make a wild guess로 넘어가요.

cards.ko: 이 앱은 제 역할을 톡톡히 해요
cards.en: This app does its job.
cards.gram: do its job = 제 역할을 하다. 물건·기계·약이 할 일을 제대로 할 때 써요. 예: The medicine did its job. (약이 효과가 있었어요)

cards.ko: 식기세척기는 시간을 정말 많이 아껴 줘요
cards.en: A dishwasher is really time-saving.
cards.gram: time-saving = 시간을 절약해 주는(형용사). Technology 질문에 바로 쓸 수 있어요.

cards.ko: 오늘은 사람 만날 에너지가 다 떨어졌어요
cards.en: My social battery is dead today.
cards.gram: social battery = 사람 만날 에너지. 다 떨어졌으면 is dead / is low.

cards.ko: 저는 내향적인 사람이라서 혼자 있는 시간이 필요해요
cards.en: I'm an introvert, so I need some time alone.
cards.gram: introvert = 내향적인 사람(명사, a/an 필요). introverted = 내향적인(형용사): I'm introverted.

cards.ko: 가족과 시간을 보내는 건 중요해요 (It is로 시작)
cards.en: It is important to have time with my family.
cards.gram: It is + 형용사 + to + 동사원형. spend time with my family도 좋아요.

cards.ko: 가족과 시간을 보내는 건 중요해요 (-ing로 시작)
cards.en: Having time with my family is important.
cards.gram: 동명사 주어(-ing) + 동사. 주어가 하나라서 is.

cards.en: I should've helped my mom cook.
cards.gram: should have + p.p. = ~할걸 그랬다(후회). help + 사람 + 동사원형: helped my mom cook.

cards.en: I used to wake up early in the morning.
cards.gram: used to + 동사원형 = 예전엔 ~했다(지금은 안 함).

cards.ko: 저는 아침에 일찍 일어나는 게 익숙해요
cards.en: I'm used to getting up early in the morning.
cards.gram: be used to + -ing = ~에 익숙하다. used to + 동사원형(예전엔 ~했다)과 헷갈리지 않기.

cards.en: I used to go to work by bus every day.
cards.gram: used to + 동사원형 = 예전엔 ~했다(지금은 안 함).

cards.ko: 어렸을 때 저는 채소를 안 먹곤 했어요
cards.en: When I was a child, I didn't use to eat vegetables.
cards.gram: 부정은 didn't use to + 동사원형 (didn't used to ❌, d 빼기).

cards.ko: 예전에는 커피를 안 마셨는데, 지금은 매일 마셔요
cards.en: I didn't use to drink coffee, but now I drink it every day.
cards.gram: 과거 습관(didn't use to)과 지금 습관(현재형)을 한 문장에서 대비해요.

cards.en: I'm used to staying up late.
cards.gram: be used to + -ing = ~에 익숙하다. to 뒤에 동사원형 ❌ → staying.

cards.ko: 저는 아직 영국 날씨에 익숙하지 않아요
cards.en: I'm not used to the British weather yet.
cards.gram: be used to + 명사도 돼요: I'm used to the weather.

cards.ko: 처음엔 힘들었지만, 이제는 혼자 사는 게 익숙해졌어요
cards.en: It was hard at first, but now I've got used to living alone.
cards.gram: 익숙해지다(변화) = get used to + -ing. I've got used to living alone.

cards.ko: 저는 예전엔 늦잠을 잤는데, 이제는 일찍 일어나는 게 익숙해요
cards.en: I used to sleep in, but now I'm used to getting up early.
cards.gram: 한 문장에 둘 다: used to + 동사원형(예전 습관) / be used to + -ing(익숙함).

cards.en: We don't often go to the bank.
cards.gram: go 뒤에 장소가 오면 to: go to the bank. 은행·우체국은 보통 the를 붙여요.

cards.ko: 새로운 걸 해 보려고 익숙한 데서 벗어나려고 해요
cards.en: I try to step out of my comfort zone.
cards.gram: step out of my comfort zone = 익숙한 영역에서 벗어나다. Part 2 경험 말할 때 좋아요.

cards.en: She successfully had her own business.
cards.gram: 동사(had)를 꾸밀 땐 부사 successfully. 명사 앞엔 형용사: a successful business.

cards.en: Most people love weekends.
cards.gram: '대부분의 사람들' = most people. almost는 부사라 명사 앞에 바로 못 와요(almost all people은 OK).
